title: Attendance Register
prompt:
Record attendance and calculate attendance percentages.

Skills: COUNTIF, dates and conditional formatting.

Use the supplied synthetic CSV at assets/data/practical-06-attendance-register.csv. A small copy/pastable sample is included below in case the CSV is not directly downloadable from the lesson page. Complete the work in a separate .xlsx copy, preserve a raw-data sheet, and check the result against the acceptance criteria. Then answer the short grading check; it does not validate the workbook itself.

Sample CSV (synthetic):
StudentID,Name,Day1,Day2,Day3,Day4,Day5
S01,Asha,P,P,A,P,P
S02,Dev,P,A,P,P,P
S03,Mira,A,P,P,A,P
objective: Record attendance and calculate attendance percentages.

starter.instructions: Open/import the UTF-8 CSV into Excel. Keep the original source data unchanged and perform work on a separate sheet or workbook.

expected_output: Expected: totals and attendance percentage agree with status cells; blank or unrecognized statuses are flagged.

public_tests.name: Sample-data acceptance
checklist: Input records are preserved and data types are checked.
Totals/results reconcile with a small independent calculation.
An edge case, duplicate or threshold boundary is tested where relevant.

public_tests.name: Server-side answer check
public_tests.note: A text/choice check does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook artifact.

acceptance_criteria: Expected: totals and attendance percentage agree with status cells; blank or unrecognized statuses are flagged.
Use a labeled result area and document formulas, assumptions or transformation steps.
Compare actual results with a manual/independently calculated expected result and test one edge case.
Keep source data intact and request human review of the completed workbook; do not treat the text grader as artifact validation.
hints: Import data without losing dates, decimals or leading zeros.
Separate raw inputs, calculations and presentation outputs.
Test empty inputs, duplicated keys, boundary values or missing matches as appropriate to the scenario.
grading_method: Server-side exact_text check of the submitted answer/expression only; does not execute Excel or inspect the workbook. This workbook-practice task needs a human-reviewed artifact and test evidence for full acceptance. Calculates present days divided by recorded day cells in the five-day sample.
retry_policy: Retries are permitted. A failed string/choice submission does not complete the exercise. Course files do not define XP; platform-wide server logic applies.
